TITLE: Linear
UNAVAILABLE: The Linear integration is not loaded on this server (LINEAR_ENABLED is off).
NOT_CONFIGURED: The Linear OAuth application is not configured on this server (LINEAR_CLIENT_ID, LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET, the callback URL). Nobody can connect until it is.

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect your Linear workspace
CONNECT.TEXT: You will authorize this platform in Linear and come back here. Then map Linear teams to projects, import their issues as tasks, and keep them in sync.

CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_configured: The Linear OAuth application is not configured on this server.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.denied: Linear did not authorize the connection.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.invalid_state: The connect flow expired or was already used. Start it again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.exchange_failed: Linear refused the authorization code. Start the flow again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.workspace_unreadable: The workspace could not be read after authorizing.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_saved: The connection could not be saved.

REASONS.token_refused: Linear refused the token. Connect again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Linear settings
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect Linear from this organization? The mappings go; the imported tasks stay.

MAPPINGS.TITLE: Teams and projects
MAPPINGS.INTRO: Each Linear team maps to one project. Inbound brings the team's issues in as tasks; outbound sends the project's tasks to the team (one outbound mapping per project).
MAPPINGS.STATE_MAP_HINT: The task status name an issue gets for each kind of Linear workflow state.
MAPPINGS.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this mapping? The imported tasks stay.
MAPPINGS.IMPORT_STARTED: The import started; see the runs below.
MAPPINGS.NO_TEAMS: The workspace has no team the connection can see.

RUNS.TITLE: Runs
RUNS.SHOW_CONFLICTS: List the conflicts this run found

CONFLICTS.TITLE: Sync conflicts
CONFLICTS.INTRO: A field changed both in Linear and on the platform since they last agreed. Linear's value was applied to the task, and the task's value is kept here: keep Linear's value, or restore the task's (a mapping that sends changes out sends it to the issue too).
CONFLICTS.KEPT_EXTERNAL: Resolved: the task keeps the value it has now.
CONFLICTS.KEPT_PLATFORM: The task's value was written back.

ERRORS.STALE: The task changed since the conflict was found, so its value was not written back. Keep Linear's value, or edit the task.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This conflict was resolved already; the list was read again.
